- Kept the existing in-place `sort(int[])` and range `sort(int[], int, int)` APIs intact in [HeapSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSort.java#L18-L47).
